subject: How to advertise my shiny application

messages.author: c52d421e18f03e10
messages.subject: How to advertise my shiny application
parts:
Dear all,

I have launched my first personal shiny application last week, that allows you to visualize R package downloads by country, and also compare the number of times different R packages have been downloaded via RStudio CRAN mirror over time.

https://craigwang.shinyapps.io/rPackageStats/

However it can not be searched on google using any keywords or part of texts, and I do not own a blog to write about it. 

What are the effective ways of advertising my application?

Thanks for any inputs,
Craig

messages.author: 63a8a907e46f9a9d
messages.subject: Re: How to advertise my shiny application
parts:
Craig,

I would suggest to  1) post in LinkedIn groups (you may need to join them first - ex. data mining, visualization group etc), 2) tweet about your tool using hashtags (#visualization, #R etc), 3) write a post to google++ groups (there are many vix groups) 4) if you can - start a wordpress blog that can be liked to google++, linkedIn and twitter. What is great about wordpress - you will see statistics such as where your audience heard about your tool (ex. twitter, linkedIn etc)

Make sure to use keywords such as visualization, R, quantitative analysis (maybe other important words) for each post. 

By the way - Nice app!

(PS - as an example - google Language Variation Suite (my shiny app and how I spread the word about it :) Let me know if you need more information.

Best,
Olga S.
